character.description: A clearly designed recurring game character with a distinctive face, silhouette and physical proportions
character.face: specific facial geometry that must remain recognizably identical across the sequence
character.hair: distinctive hairstyle with stable length, shape and colour
character.build: stable body proportions and silhouette across every shot
character.costume: the campaign default costume unless a shot explicitly changes it
signatureDetails: do not redesign the subject between shots

style.name: project-production-art
style.description: Specific authored game production art with intentional composition, physical materials and coherent art direction rather than generic AI illustration
style.period: follow the project's actual visual world and era
style.lighting: motivated scene lighting with readable forms and purposeful contrast

continuity_locks: keep recurring costume construction stable unless the shot explicitly changes it
do not silently redesign props or environment anchors

shots.description: Primary identity anchor image establishing the definitive character design
shots.pose: relaxed standing pose with clear readable silhouette
shots.camera: eye-level three-quarter portrait with natural perspective
shots.background: simple project-appropriate environment with minimal distractions
continuityLocks: this shot establishes the identity anchor for later shots

shots.description: Same character seen from a controlled side angle
shots.pose: standing side pose preserving the same proportions
shots.background: same environment family as the anchor
shots.framing: full figure with the same scale as the anchor

shots.description: Same character seated naturally without changing identity or costume construction
shots.pose: natural seated pose with believable weight distribution
shots.framing: character remains the clear focal point

shots.description: Same character performing a project-specific action while retaining the established identity
shots.pose: dynamic readable action pose with correct anatomy
shots.framing: leave clear action space in the direction of movement
